versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Ralph Wiggum - AI Loop Technique skill.
- Enables automated, iterative code or text improvement using an LLM via a Generator > Critic > Fixer > Verifier loop.
- Provides a bash script (`ralph-loop.sh`) with options for file, inline code, custom prompts, iteration limit, output format, and model selection.
- Includes a modular architecture and Python API for direct integration.
- Comprehensive documentation with usage examples, troubleshooting, and detailed prompt engineering.
